$comment: The highlights of each release line (MAJOR.MINOR), read by the What's new page at nekkoagent.com/whatsnew (scripts/build-docs.mjs). date and tag are the line's newest release; authors are the GitHub logins of the pull request's author; contributors are the logins of everyone who merged a pull request in the line (from its GitHub release notes, bots left out). Optional per highlight: "major": true puts it among the line's headliners, and the rest show as one-liners; "kind" (improvement, performance or fix) tags a one-liner. A line with no major highlight keeps the plain list.
